newsitem.title: USA: United Meridian, Shell set deep water effort.
newsitem.headline: United Meridian, Shell set deep water effort.

text.p: United Meridian Corp said Friday it and Shell Exploration Africa BV signed a production sharing contract with the Ivory Coast for the country's first deepwater offshore block.
The contract covers the 512,000-acre Block CI-105, also known as Entente, which lies in water depths ranging from 1,500 feet (500 meters) to over 6,000 feet (2,000 meters).
United Meridian said the partnership intends to start a 3-D seismic survey in October.

The company said it and the Royal Dutch/Shell Group company hold respective 35-percent and 55-percent working interests in Block CI-105. PETROCI, the national oil company of Cote d'Ivoire, has 10 percent.
United Meridian said it will be operator in the exploration phase. Shell will be operator in the development and production phase if a discovery is made.
